title: Minisforum MS-01, 3 x M.2 (PCIe 4.0 x4, 3.0 x4 with U.2 support, 3.0 x2) plus one PCIe x16 slot (x8 electrical)
notes: SMBIOS describes slots this machine does not have, so every bay is identified by its root port. The PCIe 4.0 x4 slot is the CPU's 0000:00:06.0 and the PCIe 3.0 x4 slot (which also takes a U.2 drive on an adapter) is the PCH's 0000:00:1c.4. The PCIe 3.0 x2 slot's root port is hidden by firmware while the slot is empty and has not been seen yet, so that bay carries no identity; `drivelist hardware check HOST` names the port once a drive is in it. The x16 slot is 0000:00:01.0. 00:06.2 is the dual X710, 1c.0 and 1d.0 the i226 NICs, 1d.3 the Wi-Fi card, and 07.x the Thunderbolt ports; none is a drive bay. The model string is the DMI product name; confirm it reads MS-01 on the host.
